messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — launching small PLG experiment tied to next week's developer webinar. Idea: 3-day limited credits + curated prompt packs to drive first-run completions. Goal: raise 24h activation and collect prompt-feedback.
Marco: Good. Audience = new signups last 45 days who haven't used prompts. What's the credit size we test?
Aisha: Two arms: small (400 tokens) and big (1200 tokens). Canary = 75 users each. Full = up to 4k overall.
Ruth: Routing rules proposal: if lead.source == 'inbound_partners' or company.employee_count > 100 => route to SDR; else enroll in onboarding + webinar invite. We'll include a follow-up email 24h after credit award.
Eli: Tracking events: credit_granted (amount, variant), prompt_pack_used (pack_id), first_run_completed. I'll create a dashboard with cohorts by variant and a quick metric: CTR -> register -> first_run.
Marco: Messaging tests: Variant A highlights "curated prompt templates for product teams"; Variant B leans into "instant credits to try features". We'll tag as promo_v2_A/B.
PromoBot: Heads-up: landing page must include data attributes `data-test=promo_v2` and updated meta og:image. Deploy due 36h prior.
Aisha: Social plan — three posts across X, LinkedIn: announce (72h out), reminder (24h), last-chance (2h). Marco will draft short copy.
Marco: I'll post copies by EOD. Also need short benchmark blurb for the launch doc: one-liner + CTA. Draft: "Ship faster with Redwood — claim developer credits + prompt packs at our live workshop." CTA: "Reserve your seat and claim credits"
Eli: Small SQL for initial cohort: `SELECT variant, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN first_run_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM events WHERE event_date >= '2024-05-01' AND credit_granted GROUP BY variant;`
Ruth: I'll wire the webhook to include lead_id, variant, credit_code, and forward to CRM. Add a failure retry.
Aisha: OK owners — Marco social, Ruth routing/webhooks, Eli metrics, me on creative + prompt-pack curation. Reconvene tomorrow 9:30am PT to approve landing copy.
Marco: :rocket:
